objective_name: Confirmed-date invoice references per observed month (exploratory subset)
target_definition: Count distinct Invoice Num references in the source workbook whose every detail row has one consistent, unambiguously day-first Invoice Date, grouped by observed calendar month.
known_limitations: This is a confirmed-date subset, not total invoice volume.
The exact invoice reference is assumed unique within this workbook only.
Unresolved dates are excluded and may create month-dependent undercounts.
No zero periods were inserted; absent months mean unknown, not zero.
No semantic approval, execution authorization, or publication receipt was created.
The two-period historical comparator is not a reliable forecast-performance estimate.
